title: Shopper Support Academy — Payout-Card Settlement of Cartwise Shopper Batches Shown-Pay Adjustments
content:
A shown-pay adjustment on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch is settled by the payout-card method, applied to the sum formed from the claimed amount (after any share applying to it) and any credits added to it. The method follows the plan of the shopper's payout account in Cartwise Shopper Payouts:

- for an **Everyday Pay Card plan at Gold, Platinum or Diamond** (fuel cashback of 3 percent or more) the sum is **multiplied by 1.05 and rounded up to the cent**;
- for the **Everyday Pay Card Blue** plan (fuel cashback above zero and below 3 percent) it is **multiplied by 1.02 and rounded down to the cent**;
- for **every other payout plan** the sum stands as it is.

The figure that results is rounded once more to the cent half up and booked as the adjustment amount.

## Training questions

**Which record is read?** The plan of the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Payouts account.

**What about Weekly Direct Deposit or Instant Cashout?** Neither is an Everyday Pay Card plan paying fuel cashback: the sum stands as it is.

**Which direction does each card round?** The Gold-and-above cards round up; the Blue card rounds down.

## Hypothetical sums

| Payout plan | Sum | Settled |
|---|---|---|
| Everyday Pay Card Diamond | 3.35 | 3.35 multiplied by 1.05 is 3.5175, rounded up to 3.52 |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | 3.35 | 3.35 multiplied by 1.02 is 3.417, rounded down to 3.41 |
| Weekly Direct Deposit | 3.35 | 3.35 |
